derivation:
by
  simpa only [DFunLike.ext_iff] using
    (ContinuousMap.cancel_left (f := g.toContinuousMap) (g₁ := f₁.toContinuousMap) (g₂ := f₂.toContinuousMap) hg)
explanation: Apply cancellation for continuous maps after forgetting monotonicity. Extensionality identifies both bundled equalities with the original ones. The candidate has an independent proof.
